Change c0365. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. II; 1831 Ch. XIX.

Context before (unchanged): I did not doubt but that the monster followed me, and would discover himself to me when I should have finished, that he might receive his companion.

1818 text: With this resolution I traversed the northern highlands, and fixed on one of the remotest of the Orkneys as the scene labours.

1831 text: With this resolution I traversed the northern highlands, and fixed on one of the remotest of the Orkneys as the scene of my labours.

Diff: With this resolution I traversed the northern highlands, and fixed on one of the remotest of the Orkneys as the scene {+of my+} labours.

Context after (unchanged): It was a place fitted for such a work, being hardly more than a rock, whose high sides were continually beaten upon by the waves.

result.rationale: The 1831 insertion of "of my" restores the missing article-phrase "the scene of my labours" (1818 reads "the scene labours"). It adds only a possessive, a grammatical repair with no change to events or characterization.
